safety.text: Kluwe indicated support for shifting public safety responses for homelessness and mental health calls to trained social service providers.
safety.quote: Will you support policies that shift public safety responses to trained social service providers for homelessness and mental health incidents? Chris Kluwe ( d ) Yes

sentencing.text: Kluwe agreed with prioritizing crime prevention solutions over lengthening criminal sentences and classifying more low-level crimes as felonies.
sentencing.quote: Do you agree with crime prevention solutions over increasing sentences and classifying more low level crimes as felonies? Chris Kluwe ( d ) Yes

immigration.text: Kluwe opposes discriminatory immigration raids and detention without evidence or due process.
immigration.quote: Do you publicly oppose the Department of Homeland Security’s unlawful actions which have resulted in racially discriminatory raids across the state and country, detaining people without evidence or due process simply because of the color of their skin, the language they speak, or the work they do? X YES ☐ NO

housing.text: She signed the official argument for a charter amendment intended to subject certain zoning changes to voter approval and prevent rapid development.
housing.quote: By voting “yes” on this proposed Charter Amendment, the people of Huntington Beach gain the power to protect Huntington Beach’s environment from rapid over-development by legislators, builders, and developers.

voting.text: As mayor, she signed an official letter defending Huntington Beach's voter-identification requirement and opposing legislation that would bar it.
voting.quote: In March 2024, the residents of Huntington Beach voted to update Section 702 of the Huntington Beach City Charter providing for voter identification to protect the City’s elections.
